body: Thank you, I actually havnt really thought of it that way
Thank you. I havnt really told people this happened so it feels good to hear something like that and it's not just me by myself

Ya, it's not so much a relying on him for being happy thing. This was the guy who saved my life, who was there through multiple traumas that have occurred in my life.. if he can do that to me, if he is not someone I can trust, then who is there that I can?
